statusDefinitions.live: Publicly deployed and intended to be playable now.
statusDefinitions.restore-ready: Playable build exists; only repair/packaging/smoke-test blocks public release.
statusDefinitions.release-candidate: Substantial/complete playable build exists; requires release-gate validation or limited polish.
statusDefinitions.mvp-build: Prototype or predecessor exists; defined v1 MVP work remains.
statusDefinitions.concept: Designed/discussed but intended game has not yet been implemented.
statusDefinitions.experimental: Playable experiment requiring explicit experimental framing and fallback behavior.
